draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in its training annotations: its mean test F1 drops by at most 1.8 points (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points at 10%, 20% and 30% noise), within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion at every tested noise rate.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops 0.6/1.3/1.8 points, all within the 2.0-point robustness criterion, while the baseline drops 2.6/5.5/8.9. The evidence supports a stronger claim than "somewhat robust" — it meets the pre-specified robustness criterion at all tested noise rates.
